# Independent audit: energy-maximal deepest stratum

Audited in full:
`candidate ce31fbbf06cede9c`.
Also read its optional payment dependency,
`candidate 1b856082117c9e20`, Sections1--2.

**PASS, no correction needed.** This is an exact geometric stratum
statement, not a deformation or a general OC proof.

1. The real depth superlevel set is correctly distinguished from the
   set of mixed-integer maximizers. Closed through-point cap masses
   are upper semicontinuous, their infimum is upper semicontinuous,
   and the halfspace argument proves quasiconcavity. Positivity of
   the actual maximum follows from an own-fiber interior ball.
2. The finite support-majorant claim is valid even at boundary base
   points. Farkas infeasibility supplies nonnegative coefficients
   with zero displacement barycenter and strictly positive weighted
   support excess. Normalizing contradicts the actual anchored
   Minkowski inclusion. Thus an own-boundary source has an actual
   ambient supporting cap of zero mixed volume.
3. Strict inclusion of full-dimensional compact convex bodies creates
   positive volume difference. Evaluating at the LARGER body's
   attained projective minimizer proves strict energy monotonicity
   in the required direction; no minimizer-domain reversal occurs.
4. The deepest actual set is compact, lies in the interiors of finitely
   many fibers, and hence has attained positive maximal energy. Strict
   fixed-body energy concavity gives exactly one marked maximizer
   at each selected base.
5. For every integer anchored relation inside the selected stratum,
   the convex real depth superlevel set retains the interpolated
   marked point. Maximality, inclusion monotonicity and joint energy
   concavity therefore give the equality chain(8). The complete
   marked-homothety equality theorem applies. Equal energy removes
   the scale factors; strict inclusion removes the possible excess
   of the target fiber. The statement about identical centered
   bodies is thus valid on EVERY actual anchored relation, not just
   one parity forest.
6. Lattice completeness of the selected base follows from arbitrary
   integer convex combinations. No unsupported global affine marked
   graph is inferred when the anchored-relation hypergraph is
   disconnected.
7. The optional depth payment uses a genuinely lattice-complete
   restricted actual family. Every same-parity pair has the required
   ordinary-centroid midpoint identity because the centered bodies
   agree along that relation. The archived strict payment applies
   exactly when the restricted base has more points than parities.
   Original cap measure dominates the restricted measure at the
   paying point. The resulting original-mass restriction is correct
   but does not show the selected stratum carries enough mass.

The new ordinary energy gives exact rigidity of an attained selected
stratum. Nothing in this audit supplies contact freedom, a feasible
descent, or exhaustion of all deepest bases.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
